    while granularity <= len(items):
        # try to remove chunks of current size from left to right
        removed = False
        i = 0

            # chunk from i to i+granularity-1
            # copy items without that chunk
            candidate = items[:i] + items[i+granularity:]
            attempts += 1
            # check if required items remain (as subset)
            if all(r in candidate for r in required):
                # accept removal
                items = candidate
                removed = True
                # after removal, we restart with slightly coarser granularity (increase by 1)
                granularity += 1
                # break out of inner loop to start over from left with new granularity
                break  # exit inner while, go back to outer while (will re-check condition)
            else:
                i += 1
        if not removed:
            # no removal succeeded in this pass, double granularity
            granularity *= 2
        # continue while loop; condition re-evaluated with updated items and granularity

    # After loop, items is the reduced list
    # Determine one_minimal: check if any single item can be removed while preserving required
    one_minimal = True

        if all(r in candidate for r in required):

        "attempts": attempts,
        "one_minimal": one_minimal,
        "reduced_items": items
    }
